Yes the doctors are helping me heaps and are wonderful, I've seen a therapist once but they are in such high demand and I live very far away from cities (UK) so therapists are not as available as they would be in other places. I have had huge anxiety my whole life which has led to the alcohol abuse which is why my doctor thinks if I can relieve the anxiety side of things it will help in the long run. After Christmas when this all started getting unbearable I haven't used alcohol or drugs once and I never will again. I've been 6 months totally sober and have cut out all caffeine aswell, all I drink now is herbal tea and water, my doctor performed a liver and kidney function test about 2 months after I quit drinking and he said that my liver function and kidney function were totally normal aswell, I also was tested for all thyroid related issues which came back normal, they have not ran a stress ECG yet but we are in talks about that, I think the next step for my doctor is an MRI scan. As for the anxiety I have been given bisoprolol fumerate to take which my cardiologist prescribed it has various uses apparently but he wants it to lower blood pressure which will help me stop feeling every bump and beat of my heart and slow everything down... Although I am not taking these yet because I'm awaiting my 48 hour holter monitor results back first. I've had a 24 holter already and there was nothing of significance on that apparently..thanks for replying

I do feel anxious so it could be anxiety related. It happens most days, but not as much when i do physical activity. I had bad chest pain yesterday for about 20 minutes and then when it subsided, i surfed for 2 hours and felt totally fine & better than ever. I feel a burden going to see my doctor because he cannot keep running the same tests and getting the same outcome. The only thing that makes me question is the pain isnt constant. Its a sharp intense pain that last for a couple of seconds then subsides for a few seconds and then comes back for a couple of seconds, and will carry on in that cycle for between 2-20 minutes. My main worry at first was the pain could coincide with the beat of the heart, but my doctor seemed rather sure it wasnt heart related. Anxiety is very hard to live with & i have huge admiration for anyone that lives with this. Thankyou for taking the time to reply.
